verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Gusto's time-off APIs support balance checking, request submission, and admin approval integrated with payroll (gusto-docs-11,29,33,19), and note partners can record approved time off without rebuilding approval logic (gusto-docs-12). However, there is no explicit evidence of ops users configuring custom accrual policies (rates, caps, carryover) — the emphasis is on API-driven request/approval flows rather than policy definition, so full policy-design capability is unproven.
